# The PSP files daybreak --extract-psp collects, and the bytes it must find.
#
# One line per file: the path inside PSP_GAME/USRDIR (no leading slash), the size of the
# inflated payload, then its SHA-256. The extractor reads the pack's own index, inflates
# each entry and refuses the dump when a hash differs, so a re-encoded or damaged ISO is
# caught here and no single ISO build is required.
#
# Nothing here is game data: paths, sizes and hashes only. The player's own copy of the
# game supplies the bytes (docs/psp/README.md).
#
# chr17/18/19 are the three fighters only the PSP version has. chr02 is PSP Keiichi, kept
# as the comparison fighter for the moveset and art work, and the select/VS sheets below
# are the three's plus Keiichi's so the art can be judged side by side.
#
# path	size	sha256
